text: Neurology is an important branch of clinical medicine, mainly studying the etiology, pathology, clinical manifestations, diagnosis, treatment and prevention of diseases in the nervous system (including the brain, spinal cord, peripheral nerves and muscles). The course aims to enable students to master the basic theories, clinical thinking methods and diagnosis and treatment skills of neurological diseases, cultivate their ability to make differential diagnoses of neurological diseases, and lay a foundation for clinical practice.
